meta.portfolio_scope: Provider platform services across K–12, Higher Education and Community College tenants
meta.role_boundary: Platform Admin governs SLO standards and versions, reliability exceptions, escalation policy, maintenance SLO treatment, recovery/corrective assurance and evidence. Platform Operations and specialist reliability teams detect, acknowledge, investigate, recover and execute operational changes. Business/CAB authorities retain execution approval and authorized risk acceptance where required.
meta.governance_principle: Platform Admin governs the reliability control framework and verifies evidence; specialist teams execute operational work and designated business/CAB authorities approve business-risk or maintenance execution decisions.
meta.data_classification: Governed demonstration snapshot — not a live telemetry feed
meta.monitoring_methodology: Observed ratios are computed from eligible successful/total samples; excluded samples require valid recorded exclusion basis. Error-budget remaining and burn ratios are separately sourced period aggregates and must not be extrapolated from sample ratios.

incidents.title: Pipeline completion rate below SLO
incidents.customer_impact: Four tenant batch windows delayed by 18–32 minutes; no confirmed data loss.
incidents.recovery_position: Traffic shifted from affected worker pool; backlog declining.

incidents.resolution_criteria: Success rate ≥99% and oldest queued run <10 minutes for 30 consecutive minutes.

incidents.resolution_criteria: 5xx rate <0.1% and 1h burn rate <1.0x for 60 minutes.

reliability_exceptions.title: Pipeline completion reliability risk acceptance request
reliability_exceptions.scope: Pipeline completion SLO for delayed production batch windows while worker-pool recovery is in progress.
reliability_exceptions.risk_position: SLO breached; four tenant batch windows delayed; no confirmed data loss.
reliability_exceptions.conditions: No data loss; backlog must continuously decline; customer updates every 2 hours; no expansion beyond listed production batch windows.
reliability_exceptions.compensating_controls: Traffic shifted from affected worker pool; rollback-ready pool retained; enhanced specialist monitoring active.
reliability_exceptions.exit_criteria: Pipeline success ≥99% and oldest queued run <10 minutes for 60 minutes; then close exception and return to normal SLO governance.

reliability_exceptions.title: API dependency timeout temporary reliability exception
reliability_exceptions.scope: Connector-management write operations affected by upstream dependency timeout behavior.
reliability_exceptions.risk_position: Elevated retry rate; read-only catalog traffic unaffected.
reliability_exceptions.conditions: Retry rate <2%; no impact to read-only traffic; incident communication maintained if customer impact exceeds 1%.
reliability_exceptions.compensating_controls: Circuit-breaker mitigation and increased specialist monitoring.
reliability_exceptions.decision: Authorized — Closed After Exit Criteria Met
reliability_exceptions.closure_outcome: Exit criteria met; exception closed before expiry.

reliability_exceptions.title: Query latency maintenance exception
reliability_exceptions.scope: Interactive query latency during governed warehouse migration window.
reliability_exceptions.risk_position: Temporary latency increase accepted within defined migration window.
reliability_exceptions.conditions: No availability loss; query latency may not exceed 8 seconds p95; all overrun remains SLO-accountable.
reliability_exceptions.compensating_controls: Traffic drain and rollback path verified.
reliability_exceptions.exit_criteria: Migration complete and p95 <3 seconds for 30 minutes.
reliability_exceptions.closure_outcome: Closed after successful migration and recovery validation.

reliability_exceptions.title: Identity federation transition risk acceptance
reliability_exceptions.scope: Federated sign-in transactions for two migrating education tenants during planned metadata cutover.
reliability_exceptions.risk_position: Temporary increase in authentication retries may occur during federation metadata propagation; no credential weakening permitted.
reliability_exceptions.conditions: No bypass of MFA or tenant identity policy; retry rate <1%; immediate rollback if sign-in success drops below 99.5%.
reliability_exceptions.compensating_controls: Parallel federation metadata validation and rollback-ready prior configuration.
reliability_exceptions.exit_criteria: Federation propagation complete and sign-in success ≥99.96% for 30 minutes.

reliability_exceptions.title: API dependency retry risk acceptance
reliability_exceptions.scope: Connector-management write requests only while upstream dependency stabilization is verified.
reliability_exceptions.risk_position: Elevated retries remain within authorized bounds; read-only APIs unaffected.
reliability_exceptions.conditions: 5xx <0.5%; no read API impact; customer communication required if connector writes exceed 2% failure.
reliability_exceptions.compensating_controls: Circuit breaker, bounded retries and enhanced specialist monitoring.
